summary: A fix release for the account tools and the documentation that describes them. `estimate_anlas_cost` advertised img2img and infill and then failed on both; it now returns an estimate. The documentation site had 87 dead links and a cost table that matched no configuration.

highlights.title: An estimate that estimates
highlights.body: `estimate_anlas_cost` accepts `generate`, `img2img` and `infill`, and its docstring promises that `strength` scales an img2img estimate — but every image-conditioned call raised `image-conditioned actions require an image`. It builds a request to reach the price formula, and that request wanted an image the formula never uses. `GenerationRequest` gained an `estimate_only` flag that relaxes the payload requirements for estimation while keeping every check that can move the price; the real generation path still enforces all of them, and the tests that prove it are the ones that were already there.

highlights.title: A documentation site with no dead links
highlights.body: The site had 87. Eighty came from the breadcrumb trail injected above each article, which walked one directory too far up: every page under `tools/`, `tutorials/`, `transports/`, `development/` and `api/` pointed at a `../../index.html` that does not exist. The other seven came from Sphinx's `viewcode`, whose back-links named the module a definition was re-exported through rather than the one it is documented under.

highlights.title: Numbers that came from the tool
highlights.body: The account page documented `perStepUsage` and `subscriptionId` on the subscription response; neither exists, and its example payload would have raised a `KeyError`. The Anlas cost table listed 2, 5, 5 and 7 for four resolutions at 28 steps, which matches no configuration — the tool returns 8, 20, 20 and 30 without Opus, and 0, 0, 0 and 30 with it. Both are rewritten from a live response and from measured output, in all three languages.

sections.title: 🐛 Fixed
items: `estimate_anlas_cost` works for `img2img` and `infill` instead of raising `image-conditioned actions require an image`.

`GenerationRequest` gained `estimate_only`, which relaxes the image, mask and inpaint-model requirements for estimation only. Price inputs stay validated in both modes, and the real generation path is unchanged.
`get_subscription` and `estimate_anlas_cost` no longer document `perStepUsage`, `subscriptionId` or a `usage` field; the subscription response exposes none of them.
The Anlas cost table is rebuilt from measured output, as two sub-tables (txt2img, and img2img at strength 0.5) with both Opus columns.
The quickstart example payload uses keys the API actually returns, checked key by key.
The English site's 87 dead links are gone: the breadcrumb trail walked one directory too far up, and `viewcode` back-links named the wrong module.
The Chinese and Japanese `installation.md` are aligned with the English source on headings, admonitions, bullets, link targets and code blocks.

sections.title: 📚 Documentation
items: New `api/audit.md` in all three languages: when a record is written, its fields, the redaction rules, the `O_APPEND` concurrency property, and why an unwritable trail never fails a tool call.

upgrade_notes: No breaking changes. `estimate_anlas_cost` previously raised for `img2img` and `infill` and now returns an estimate, which is what its documentation always promised; callers that worked around the failure can drop the workaround. Everything else in this release is documentation. The intentional behaviour change from 0.6.0 still applies: `director_tool`'s `emotion` and `emotion_level` require the `X-MCP-Insiders` opt-in.
